rawContent: The murder of George Floyd was tragic and only one of many cases over the past year highlighting the police use of force issues in the U.S. that many Black and LatinX communities have experienced and spoken out about. #cjreform #GeorgeFloyd #BlackLivesMatter [THREAD]

The guilty verdicts in the Derek Chauvin trial today were the right verdicts. They will not bring justice and will not erase the pain of impacted communities, but they do hold Chauvin accountable and culpable for Floyd’s murder. #cjreform #GeorgeFloyd #BlackLivesMatter

Prosecuting officers or suing them for civil damages is not enough to make policing fairer in this country. It will take broader efforts, like many of the legislative policing reforms adopted around the country, to implement true change. #cjreform #GeorgeFloyd #BlackLivesMatter

We remain heartbroken for Floyd’s family and committed, as lawyers and researchers, to help make a difference in addressing injustice and reforming the criminal legal system. #cjreform #GeorgeFloyd #BlackLivesMatter

We also remain committed to giving voice to those impacted and to let their experiences inform our work as a Center around accuracy, risk, and needs in the legal system. #cjreform #GeorgeFloyd #BlackLivesMatter
